decisions.reason: The illustrated series is a multi-model line that draws on the firm's core curation strengths and its plan to broaden formats, so with industry turnover growing the firm has the slack to carry it, although its absence from the website since 2019 raises some doubt about its results.
Reissuing overlooked jazz on vinyl is the label's core competence and fits the growing demand for vinyl, so performance most likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
Multi-disc box sets are often limited editions that sell out and are not restocked, but the set stays close to the established offer and can remain in the catalog while it still sells.

Like the schlager compilation already withdrawn, this generic compilation CD was only mentioned on the website, competes in a weak CD segment, and probably falls below aspiration, so its resources are better moved to the core reissue business.
